blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—As families prepare to remember their departed loved ones this Undas, the Archdiocese of Manila has reminded Catholics that cremated remains should be laid to rest in a grave, mausoleum or columbarium. In an Oct. 24 circular released on Friday, the archdiocese cited the Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines’ Liturgical Guidelines on Cremation. “The cremated remains should be buried in a grave, mausoleum, or columbarium…the urn should not be kept permanently at home or family altar,” the guidelines read.
